shows.name: Dean Heritage Centre Christmas Market
shows.summary: A general Christmas makers' market in the Forest of Dean. Herefordshire & Worcestershire Earth Heritage Trust will have a fossil and mineral stall, raising funds for their School Fossil Box project.
shows.source_notes: Date, opening times and free entry are on the Dean Heritage Centre event pages. The Saturday page is the source. The Sunday page is the same market. The fossil and mineral stall is not on those pages.
